title: i18n: an override's own label loses to the base's translation on page, dataset, app and book, and a translation in the .custom pair never wins on any type
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

Carries item 3 of #30062 (label precedence); #30062 keeps items 1, 2, 4 and 5, and item 3's server half (the protocol's `getPackaged*Base` accessors and the REST table rows) waits on this card.

Filing gate ①: a product defect with a named locus and a measured reach, split from an in-flight p1 card because the fix lives in `packages/spec`. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes it.

## Ruling (not open to re-ruling)

On #30062, comment 6631250894, the maintainer: 「…其他全部同意」, which rules acceptance item 3 as the seat proposed: **label precedence is a translation in the pair, then the override's own label, then the base's translation.** One rule across types, and across runtime and Studio.

## Business reason

ADR-0146 D2: an item in the `.custom` package replaces the base's item. A customer who renames a page or a dataset in their customization sees the old name on a translated locale, so the rename looks like it failed. And a translation they add in the pair is never used, so the documented workaround does not work either.

## Defect (read at `origin/main` `b7075d99`, not built)

1. **The override's own label loses on four types.** In `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `translateView` (:1480), `translateDashboard`, `translateReport` and `translateObject` take `TranslateDocumentOptions` and apply the `packagedBase` rule (a value that differs from the packaged base is the author's and is kept). `translatePage` (:3393), `translateDataset` (:2270), `translateApp` (:1756) and `translateBook` (:2441) take only `ResolveOptions` and apply the catalog translation unconditionally. Matching on the server side, `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:2954` lists only object, dashboard, view and report. Measured through the API on #30062 (zh-CN CRM): page `crm_welcome` label `OVpage` served as 欢迎页; dataset `opportunity_metrics` label, description and a measure label served as the base's zh-CN text.
2. **A translation in the pair never wins, on any type.** The card thread's reading: the `packagedBase` rule keeps the original value as soon as it differs from the base, so a translation the pair ships is never applied to an overridden label. Not re-measured by the seat.

## Acceptance

1. All eight translators follow the ruled order: pair translation, then the override's own label, then the base's translation. Pin each type.
2. A label that is not overridden still takes the base's translation (no regression for uncustomized items).
3. Studio and runtime read the same answer (the report header case on #30062: runtime shows the override, Studio showed the base's text).

## Reader who acts

Spec lane, the seat that takes it from `pm:queue`. Then `domain:server` seat 5 (#28677) dispatches #30062's server half: the protocol accessors for page, dataset, app and book, and the `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` rows.

## Dedup

Searched issues, open and closed: "translatePage packagedBase" (1 hit, #28214, a closed thank-you-panel key card, unrelated); "override label translation precedence" (59 hits) and "packaged base translation page dataset label" (45 hits): beyond #30062 itself, only QA runs and closed cards on other keys; none carries this rule.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "export function translatePage" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (the signature's options type), and `git grep -n -A6 "const PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS" origin/main -- packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`.
